title: solidago arguta var. boottii
intro: Solidago arguta var. boottii, commonly known as Boott's goldenrod, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Boott's goldenrod include reducing inflammation, modulating the immune system, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
